sources.title: Model release notes - Poolside
sources.snippet: Laguna S 2.1 is a 118B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 8B activated parameters per token, built for agentic coding and long-horizon work. It sits between Laguna XS 2.1 and Laguna M.1 in the Laguna model family.

sources.title: Introducing Laguna S 2.1 - poolside.ai
sources.snippet: You can also run Laguna S 2.1 locally through atomic.chat, where it's available in GGUF and MLX across all bit-widths. For hosted access, Laguna S 2.1 is available through Baseten's Model Library and Frontier Gateway, OpenRouter, including a free endpoint and a dedicated 1M-context deployment, and Vercel AI Gateway.
